scoring_justification: T0: the paper's headline is a set of derived parameters; no richer raw artifact allows recompute of the final numbers. The checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper's reported values with domain-appropriate tolerances and enforces electroneutrality.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I and II and text (mean ionicity values explicitly stated: s=0.72 for SrTiO3, s=0.61 for BaTiO3)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied exactly from the published tables and text of the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, directly traceable to the named tables and sentences.

required.SrTiO3: object with keys Z1, Z2, Z3, alpha_M_star, s, b1, b2, b3, W, A1, B1, A2, B2, A3, B3, k1, k2

outputs.description: All computed physical quantities for SrTiO3 and BaTiO3. The checker will compare each value to the hidden paper-reported reference within tolerances and also verify electroneutrality and equilibrium conditions.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker also validates that the submitted values satisfy Z1+Z2+3Z3=0 and the equilibrium condition within reasonable tolerance, ensuring structural consistency without exposing gold values.
